summary: Static technical audit against expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js — output byte-identical to source, confirming no {{prompt:}} markers or inline fenced prompts in this file) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). This is a 3-5 min pure-prose stakes-setter lecture with zero fenced code blocks, zero **Prompt** labels, zero [Skill: name] references, and zero specific Claude Code/Desktop/Cowork capability assertions in the student-facing body — so check_prompts.md (44 rules) and the large majority of check_platform_and_boundaries.md are N/A by absence of subject matter, not by inspection failure. The live technical surface is the maintainer-block Source-verification section: three freshness-stamped claims (500K-lines demo, Agentics Helsinki meetup, million-lines rhetorical close). Ran curriculum/evals/scripts/source-freshness.sh --target 2026-07-15 against this exact file: exit 0, '0 block · 0 warn · 0 info · 3 ok'. Independently re-verified the sole URL (https://luma.com/bjg7smsc) live via WebFetch + curl (200, content matches: Helsinki Agentics Meetup, Sep 2 2025) — no paraphrase drift from the maintainer block's claim. Verified quality-stamp SHA 47f3357 is a real ancestor commit of current HEAD (not hand-typed). One non-blocking finding: the third source stamp's bracketed tag '[convergent]' is not in check_research_claims.md §1's enumerated source-type vocabulary — low priority because the claim it labels is explicitly self-declared as a non-citation rhetorical device ('not a single-source citation'), so the mandatory-label rule's applicability itself is arguable. No blocking findings.
